summary: 16-bit packed vertex-position decompressor. Computes a source uint16 pointer from this+0x18 plus this+0x1050 (row) and this+0x1054 (slice) pitch products with the two index arguments, and a loop end at v4 + this+0x1064 bytes (this+0x1058/0x1064 count fields bound the pass). Each iteration reads three consecutive uint16 words, scales each by 0.000015259022 (~2^-16), and writes four output floats: channel0 = word2 * scale, channel1 = word1 * scale, channel2 = word0 * scale, alpha = 1.0. When the this+0x10 flag is non-zero, ContactManifoldCleanup is called on the decoded float output.

operations.description: Compute source pointer v4 = (uint16*)(this+0x18 + a3 * this+0x1054 + a2 * this+0x1050) (slice and row pitch products with the index arguments).
Compute loop end bound i = v4 + this+0x1064 bytes; the total source byte count at this+0x1064 bounds the decode pass.
For-loop iterating while v4 < i; each iteration consumes three uint16 words and emits one 4-float RGBA vertex.
Scale the three source words to float with 0.000015259022; channel0 uses word2, channel1 uses word1, channel2 uses word0. The scale factor corresponds to the read-only global flt_5AD290.
Write four output floats per vertex: a4[0] = word2 * scale, a4[1] = word1 * scale, a4[2] = word0 * scale, a4[3] = 1.0 (alpha set via the loop increment).
Guard: if this+0x10 is non-zero, post-process the decoded float output.
Call ContactManifoldCleanup((int)this, &a4[-4 * this+0x1058]) on the decoded float RGBA output buffer start.
